rationale: Kobe's work on LLM and ML infrastructure complements Phan Nguyen's statistical learning and machine learning research—they operate in overlapping ML domains but from different angles (systems engineering vs. statistical methods). Phan's expertise in advanced statistical techniques and R-based tools could inform how Kobe approaches ML infrastructure problems, while Kobe's production engineering experience offers practical grounding for research applications.
intro_message: Kobe, meet Phan Nguyen — a Research Scientist at Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory focused on statistical learning and ML research. Your ML infrastructure background and his statistical methods expertise could surface useful cross-pollination ideas.
